svg.text: Every part and every wire. Coloured lines are wires; a dot is a join; lines that cross without a dot (or hop over) are not joined.
⏚ means "to GND". A bar labelled 3.3 V or 5 V means "to that supply". Small grey numbers are Pi header pin numbers (see header-map.svg). Dashed = optional or later.
to the Pi's USB_DP / USB_DM test pads (underneath, by the USB socket)
board pins: VDD GND SCL SDA ADDR ALRT A0 A1 A2 A3
ADDR to GND sets the address to 0x48
only if docs/03 step 2 reads ≥ 20 mA
Power: USB-C → TP4056 (charges the cells) → OUT+ → (switch) → MT3608 boost at 5.1 V → Pi pins 2/4. OUT− is the ground for everything.
Everything else runs from the Pi's 3.3 V (pins 1 and 17). Never feed the joystick or the ADS1115 from 5 V.
Each sense line is two 100 kΩ resistors in series; the middle point goes to the ADS1115 (A2 battery, A3 USB).
Buttons: use two diagonally opposite legs of each 4-leg switch; the Pi's built-in pull-ups do the rest. Joystick SW is a button too.
